prompt: Design a generic Provider contract for an MIT Rust library with no selected integration dependency. Identify errors and testing.
assertions: Proposes a vendor-independent public Provider request/response contract and actionable typed error variants.
Does not impose legacy routing codes or employee persistence on the generic library.
Keeps integration dependencies undecided; named crates are conditional options rather than required additions.
Proposes deterministic offline tests through the public Provider boundary without credentials or inference spend.
